# bloxone_cdc_destination_http (Resource)

Manages an HTTP Destination.

The HTTP Destination object sends Cloud Data Connector (CDC) flow data to an HTTP endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Replace credential_id with the ID of your own credential configured in the Portal
resource "bloxone_cdc_destination_http" "example" {
  name          = "example_cdc_destination_http"
  address       = "https://example1.com/ingest"
  credential_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

resource "bloxone_cdc_destination_http" "example_with_optional" {
  name               = "example_cdc_destination_http_optional"
  address            = "https://example2.com/ingest"
  credential_id      = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  output_data_format = "CIM"
  transport_protocol = "HTTPS"
  description        = "Example CDC HTTP destination"
  enabled            = true

  tags = {
    site = "Site A"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) The URL of the HTTP endpoint, e.g. `https://http.example.com/ingest`.
- `credential_id` (String) The identifier of an existing credential used to authenticate to the HTTP endpoint.
- `name` (String) The name of the HTTP destination.

### Optional

- `authentication` (String) The authentication method used to connect to the HTTP endpoint.
- `description` (String) The description of the HTTP destination. May contain 0 to 256 characters.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the HTTP destination is enabled. Defaults to _true_.
- `output_data_format` (String) The format of the data sent to the HTTP endpoint. Allowed values:

  * _ASIM_: Microsoft Sentinel
  * _CIM_: Splunk CIM

Defaults to _ASIM_.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the HTTP destination.
- `transport_protocol` (String) The transport protocol used to connect to the HTTP endpoint. Allowed values:

  * _HTTP_
  * _HTTPS_

Defaults to _HTTP_.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Time when the object has been created.
- `id` (Number) The resource identifier.
- `insecure_mode` (Boolean) Indicates whether the HTTP endpoint certificate is not verified. Always _false_: insecure mode is not supported for HTTP destinations.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) The tags for the HTTP destination, including default tags.
- `updated_at` (String) Time when the object has been updated. Equals to _created_at_ if not updated after creation.
